title: Small, chopped good, only charges on USB cord, Not a plug in.
text:
Small, chopped good, only charges on USB cord, Not a plug in.. Works good for a small garlic, veggie chopper.
3 blades, bottom one looks like it’s bent, but it’s Not, it fits the bowl.
Blades work good, but light weight.
This is a glass bowl. You Can see what your chopping, Very nice, and is cute.
Good for RV, can charge it up in a car.

That said , it is electric, But is not the Type you plug in!
You have to use the USB cord like you use on your cell iPhones to
Charge this, it came with the cord only.
The first charge took almost 3 hours!
When it’s charging it’s red, then blue for full charge. Although after I used this
I recharged it again, and took more then hour to recharge.

It says when using this, only hold the button down for not any longer
Then 30 seconds at a time. I have never timed using my other Real 4 cup electric veggie
Chopper, but you would not need that much time , unless you where chopping
Up a bunch of kale, that this is Too small for.
Although this is called a garlic chopper.

When it finally charged up, I used 1/2 bulb of fresh peeled garlic, and it chopped good.
After empty, I tried fresh Italian tomatoes I had to cut up before putting in this
Tiny chopper, then put in more 4 more times, then put in fresh parsley, then
Another small amount of fresh basil leaves, then 1/2 onion.
They all chopped up good.
Then I recharged this. Although it seemed strong enough to chop up more
At the same time. This took another hour to recharge if not longer.
As you can tell, I’m not a fan of using a kitchen chopper not having
A regular plug-in that I can depend on all the time, and this is small.
I usually chop Up two bulbs of garlic at a time, that usually last a week in my house.
We love garlic, and it’s super healthy.
But I cook allot for my family, and since Covid and my hubby had a heart attack we are
Not going out to eat, good healthy cooking at home.

I have different size choppers, food processors, but I have to say I use my
4 Cup chopper for all vegetable, and that can even chop meat. And it was less
Then $15.00 on Amazon a couple of years ago. I have two. Now I see the same
Choppers for $30.00 and up to $200.00 , why?

This is good if your just chopping garlic, or very small amounts of veggies that are not
Hard. Don’t think this small motor is strong enough to take it.

I’m giving this a 3 star, as I cannot depend on this to start every time I want to use it,
Or how long is the charge on this sitting in my pantry?
I think it is Pricey, and only has limited use only.

product_metadata.title: Electric Mini Garlic Chopper, 300ML 45W Food Chopper with 3 Pieces Stainless Steel Blades for Garlic Onion Meat Nuts Pepper Ginger Vegetables, Baby Food Maker
features: More Powerful Electric Mini Garlic Chopper: This mini food chopper is equipped with a 45W motor, which can drive 3-piece stainless steel reinforced blades to chop garlic, ginger, pepper, carrot, vegetables, onions, nuts, etc quickly. (NOTE: The blade at the bottom is originally curved. Because the bottom of the glass has a certain curvature, the blade needs to adapt to this curvature).
Larger Capacity: The upgraded version of garlic chopper includes 1* 300ML cup, 3-head blade, and 1*USB cable that can chop more meat, nuts, and vegetables one time easily.

Easy to Use and Clean: Just click the button on the top to automatically mash, and evenly chopped food can be obtained in a few seconds. The whole of the crusher is waterproof and the blade is removable. The food chopper can be rinsed directly after use, which is easy to clean and has no residue.

Safe Materials and Portability: This mini food chopper is made of BPA-free materials, 402 stainless steel blades are more resistant to rust and corrosion, and are harmless to your family. Small in size and portable, it can meet your small needs in life. It is an excellent choice for camping trips when traveling or on business trips.

Perfect Kitchen Tool: Suitable for crushed garlic/crushed ginger/crushed fresh chili/crushed peanuts/ ground meat/ pumpkin paste/ vegetable puree, a must-have artifact for food research lovers and kitchen lovers.
